A '''comlink wrist blaster''' was a wrist-mounted combination [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] was known to use this type of weapon.
